name: Bulbasaur
description: There is a plant seed on its back right from the day this POKéMON is born. The seed slowly grows larger.

name: Ivysaur
description: There is a plant bulb on its back. When it absorbs nutrients, the bulb is said to blossom into a large flower.

name: Venusaur
description: A bewitching aroma wafts from its flower. The fragrance becalms those engaged in a battle.

name: Charmander
description: From the time it is born, a flame burns at the tip of its tail. Its life would end if the flame were to go out.

name: Charmeleon
description: It lashes about with its tail to knock down its foe. It then tears up the fallen opponent with sharp claws.

name: Charizard
description: Its wings can carry this POKéMON close to an altitude of 4,600 feet. It blows out fire at very high temperatures.

name: Squirtle
description: When it retracts its long neck into its shell, it squirts out water with vigorous force.

name: Wartortle
description: This POKéMON is very popular as a pet. Its fur-covered tail is a symbol of its longevity.

name: Blastoise
description: It crushes its foe under its heavy body to cause fainting. In a pinch, it will withdraw inside its shell.

name: Caterpie
description: It is covered with a green skin. When it grows, it sheds the skin, covers itself with silk, and becomes a cocoon.

name: Metapod
description: Even though it is encased in a sturdy shell, the body inside is tender. It can't withstand a harsh attack.

name: Butterfree
description: The wings are protected by rain-repellent dust. As a result, this POKéMON can fly about even in rain.

name: Weedle
description: Often found in forests and grasslands. It has a sharp, toxic barb of around two inches on top of its head.

name: Kakuna
description: This POKéMON is in a temporary stage while making its body. It is almost completely unable to move on its own.

name: Beedrill
description: May appear in a swarm. Flies at violent speeds, all the while stabbing with the toxic stinger on its rear.

name: Pidgey
description: Does not like to fight. It hides in tall grass and so on, foraging for food such as small bugs.

name: Pidgeotto
description: The claws on its feet are well developed. It can carry prey such as an EXEGGCUTE to its nest over 60 miles away.

name: Pidgeot
description: It spreads its gorgeous wings widely to intimidate enemies. It races through the skies at Mach-2 speed.

name: Rattata
description: Its fangs are long and very sharp. They grow continuously, so it gnaws on hard things to whittle them down.

name: Raticate
description: Its rear feet have three toes each. They are webbed, enabling it to swim across rivers.

name: Spearow
description: It busily flits around here and there. Even if it is frail, it can be a tough foe that uses MIRROR MOVE.

name: Fearow
description: Its huge and magnificent wings can keep it aloft in the sky. It can remain flying a whole day without landing.

name: Ekans
description: A very common sight in grassland, etc. It flicks its tongue in and out to sense danger in its surroundings.

name: Arbok
description: The pattern on its belly appears to be a frightening face. Weak foes will flee just at the sight of the pattern.

name: Pikachu
description: It has small electric sacs on both its cheeks. If threatened, it looses electric charges from the sacs.

name: Raichu
description: Its electric charges can reach even 100,000 volts. Careless contact can cause even an Indian elephant to faint.

name: Sandshrew
description: It burrows and lives underground. If threatened, it curls itself up into a ball for protection.

name: Sandslash
description: It is adept at attacking with the spines on its back and its sharp claws while quickly scurrying about.

name: Nidoran
description: Though small, it must be treated with caution because of its powerfully toxic barbs. The female has smaller horns.

name: Nidorina
description: The female has a gentle temperament. It emits ultrasonic cries that have the power to befuddle foes.

name: Nidoqueen
description: The body is covered by stiff, needle- like scales. If it becomes excited, the needles bristle outwards.

name: Nidoran
description: Its large ears are flapped like wings when it is listening to distant sounds. It extends toxic barbs when angered.

name: Nidorino
description: It is easily angered. By swinging its well- developed horn wildly, it can even punch through diamond.

name: Nidoking
description: It is recognized by its rock-hard hide and its extended horn. Be careful with the horn as it contains venom.

name: Clefairy
description: Its adorable appearance makes it popular as a pet. However, it is rare and difficult to find.

name: Clefable
description: It has an acute sense of hearing. It can easily hear a pin being dropped nearly 1,100 yards away.

name: Vulpix
description: While young, it has six gorgeous tails. When it grows, several new tails are sprouted.

name: Ninetales
description: It has nine long tails and fur that  gleams gold. It is said to live for  1,000 years.

name: Jigglypuff
description: It captivates foes with its huge, round eyes, then lulls them to sleep by singing a soothing melody.

name: Wigglytuff
description: Its fur is extremely fine, dense, and supple. The exquisitely pleasant fur conveys an image of luxury.

name: Zubat
description: It has no eyes. Instead, it relies on its ultrasonic cries for echo location to flit about in darkness.

name: Golbat
description: It clamps down on its prey with needle- sharp fangs and drains over 10 ounces of blood in one gulp.

name: Weavile
description: It sends signals to others by carving odd patterns in frost-covered trees and ice.

name: Honchcrow
description: Becoming active at night, it is known to swarm with numerous Murkrow in tow.

name: Yanmega
description: Its jaw power is incredible. It is adept at biting apart foes while at high speed.

name: Paras
description: Growing out of the bug's back are mushrooms called tochukaso. The mushrooms grow with the bug host.

name: Parasect
description: It scatters toxic spores from the mushroom cap. In China, the spores are used as herbal medicine.

name: Venonat
description: Its eyes act as radar, enabling it to be active in darkness. The eyes can also shoot powerful beams.

name: Venomoth
description: The wings are covered with dustlike scales. Every time it flaps its wings, it looses highly toxic dust.

name: Diglett
description: It burrows through the ground at a shallow depth. It leaves raised earth in its wake, making it easy to spot.

name: Dugtrio
description: In battle, it digs through the ground and strikes the unsuspecting foe from an unexpected direction.

name: Meowth
description: All it does is sleep during the daytime. At night, it patrols its territory with its eyes aglow.

name: Persian
description: Has a vicious temperament. Beware if it raises its tail straight up. It is a signal that it is about to pounce and bite.

name: Psyduck
description: It is constantly wracked by a headache. When the headache turns intense, it begins using mysterious powers.

name: Golduck
description: The forelegs are webbed, helping to make it an adept swimmer. It can be seen swimming elegantly in lakes, etc.

name: Mankey
description: Light and agile on its feet, and ferocious in temperament. When angered, it flies into an uncontrollable frenzy.

name: Primeape
description: It is always outrageously furious. If it gives chase, it will tenaciously track the target no matter how far.

name: Growlithe
description: Very friendly and faithful to people. It will try to repel enemies by barking and biting.

name: Arcanine
description: A POKéMON that is described in Chinese legends. It is said to race at an unbelievable speed.

name: Poliwag
description: Its slick black skin is thin and damp. A part of its internal organs can be seen through the skin as a spiral pattern.

name: Poliwhirl
description: Its two legs are well developed. Even though it can live on the ground, it prefers living in water.

name: Poliwrath
description: An adept swimmer, it knows the front crawl, butterfly, and more. It is faster than the best human swimmers.

name: Abra
description: It sleeps for 18 hours a day. It uses a variety of extrasensory powers even while asleep.

name: Kadabra
description: It happened one morning - a boy with extrasensory powers awoke in bed transformed into KADABRA.

name: Alakazam
description: It does not like physical attacks very  much. Instead, it freely uses extra- sensory powers to defeat foes.

name: Machop
description: Its whole body is composed of muscles. Even though it's the size of a human child, it can hurl 100 grown-ups.

name: Machoke
description: Its formidable body never gets tired. It helps people by doing work such as the moving of heavy goods.

name: Machamp
description: Its four ruggedly developed arms can launch a flurry of 1,000 punches in just two seconds.

name: Turtwig
description: Made from soil, the shell on its back hardens when it drinks water. It  lives along lakes.

name: Grotle
description: A Grotle that lives in the forest is said to have its own secret springwater.

name: Torterra
description: Small Pokémon occasionally gather on its unmoving back to begin building their nests.

name: Tentacool
description: Its eyes are as transparent as crystals. From them, it shoots mysterious beams of light.

name: Tentacruel
description: It has 80 tentacles that move about freely. They can sting, causing poisoning and sharp, stabbing pain.

name: Geodude
description: Its round form makes it easy to pick up. Some people have used them to hurl at each other in a snowball fight.

name: Graveler
description: Be careful while hiking on mountain trails. GRAVELER may come rolling down the path without slowing.

name: Golem
description: It is enclosed in a hard shell that is as rugged as slabs of rock. It sheds skin once a year to grow larger.

name: Ponyta
description: Its body is light, and its legs are incredibly powerful. It can clear Ayers Rock in one leap.

name: Rapidash
description: It can gallop at a top speed of 150 miles per hour. It can race as fast as a bullet train while ablaze.

name: Slowpoke
description: It is always vacantly lost in thought, but no one knows what it is thinking about. It is good at fishing with its tail.

name: Slowbro
description: When a SLOWPOKE went hunting in the sea, its tail was bitten by a SHELLDER. That made it evolve into SLOWBRO.

name: Magnemite
description: It moves while constantly hovering. It discharges THUNDER WAVE and so on from the units at its sides.

name: Magneton
description: A linked cluster formed of several MAGNEMITE. It discharges powerful magnetic waves at high voltage.

name: Magnezone
description: It evolved from exposure to a special magnetic field. Three units generate magnetism.

name: Doduo
description: A two-headed POKéMON that was discovered as a sudden mutation. It runs at a pace of over 60 miles per hour.

name: Dodrio
description: An odd species that is rarely found. The three heads respectively represent joy, sadness, and anger.

name: Seel
description: Covered with light blue fur, its hide is thick and tough. It is active in bitter cold of minus 40 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Dewgong
description: Its body is covered with a pure white fur. The colder the weather, the more active it becomes.

name: Grimer
description: Sludge exposed to X rays from the moon transformed into GRIMER. It loves feeding on filthy things.

name: Muk
description: It is usually undetectable because it blends in with the ground. Touching it can cause terrible poisoning.

name: Shellder
description: It is encased in a shell that is harder than diamond. Inside, however, it is surprisingly tender.

name: Cloyster
description: Its shell is extremely hard. It cannot be shattered, even with a bomb. The shell opens only when it is attacking.

name: Gastly
description: A being that exists as a thin gas. It can topple an Indian elephant by enveloping the prey in two seconds.

name: Haunter
description: If you get the feeling of being watched in darkness when nobody is around, HAUNTER is there.

name: Gengar
description: It is said to emerge from darkness to steal the lives of those who become lost in mountains.

name: Onix
description: It usually lives underground. It searches for food while boring its way through the ground at 50 miles per hour.

name: E.Mr. Mime
description: The bright light on its tail can be seen far away.

name: Hypno
description: It carries a pendulum-like device. There once was an incident in which it took  away a child it hypnotized.

name: Krabby
description: It can be found near the sea. The large pincers grow back if they are torn out of their sockets.

name: Kingler
description: Its large and hard pincer has 10,000- horsepower strength. However, being so big, it is unwieldy to move.

name: Voltorb
description: A life-form whose identity is unknown. It is said to SCREECH or suddenly SELFDESTRUCT.

name: Electrode
description: It explodes in response to even minor stimuli. It is feared, with the nickname of The Bomb Ball.

name: M.Blaziken
description: When facing a tough foe, it looses flames from its wrists. Its powerful legs let it jump over buildings.

name: Exeggutor
description: It is called The Walking Tropical Rainforest. Each of the nuts has a face and a will of its own.

name: Cubone
description: It wears the skull of its dead mother on its head. When it becomes lonesome, it is said to cry loudly.

name: Marowak
description: It is small and was originally very weak. Its temperament turned ferocious when it began using bones.

name: Hitmonlee
description: The legs freely contract and stretch. The stretchy legs allow it to hit a distant foe with a rising kick.

name: Hitmonchan
description: The spirit of a pro boxer has infused this POKéMON. It throws punches that are faster than a bullet train.

name: Toxicroak
description: The toxin made in its poison sacs is pumped to the knuckle claws through tubes down its arms.

name: Koffing
description: Its thin, balloon-like body is inflated by horribly toxic gases. It reeks when it is nearby.

name: Weezing
description: Very rarely, a sudden mutation can result in two small KOFFING twins becoming conjoined as a WEEZING.

name: Rhyhorn
description: Strong, but not too bright, this POKéMON can shatter even a skyscraper with its charging TACKLES.

name: Rhydon
description: It begins walking on its hind legs after evolution. It can punch holes through boulders with its horn.

name: Chansey
description: It lays several eggs a day. The eggs are apparently rich in nutrients and extremely delicious.

name: Fennekin
description: Fennekin expels hot air that can reach nearly 400 degrees. It likes  to snack on twigs.

name: Kangaskhan
description: The female raises its offspring in a pouch on its belly. It is skilled at attacking using COMET PUNCH.

name: Horsea
description: It maintains balance using its tail, which is wound up like a coil. It may spray ink from its mouth.

name: Seadra
description: Its body bristles with sharp spikes. Carelessly trying to touch it could cause fainting from the spikes.

name: Goldeen
description: Its dorsal and pectoral fins are strongly developed like muscles. It can swim at a speed of five knots.

name: Seaking
description: The horn on its head is sharp like a drill. It bores a hole in a boulder to make its nest.

name: Staryu
description: It appears in large numbers by seashores. At night, its central core flashes with a red light.

name: Starmie
description: This POKéMON has a geometric body. Because of its body, the locals suspect that it is an alien creature.

name: Mr. Mime
description: It is adept at conning people. It is said to be able to create walls out of thin air by miming.

name: Scyther
description: It tears and shreds prey with its wickedly sharp scythes. It very rarely spreads its wings to fly.

name: Jynx
description: It speaks using a language that sounds human. Research is under way to determine what is being said.

name: Electabuzz
description: It loves to feed on strong electricity. It occasionally appears around large power plants and so on.

name: Magmar
description: Found near the mouth of a volcano. This fire-breather's body temperature is nearly 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Pinsir
description: Its two long pincer horns are powerful. Once they grip an enemy, they won't release until the foe is torn.

name: Tauros
description: When it is about to TACKLE, it whips its body repeatedly with its three long tails.

name: Magikarp
description: It is virtually worthless in terms of both power and speed. It is the most weak and pathetic POKéMON in the world.

name: Gyarados
description: It has an extremely aggressive nature. The HYPER BEAM it shoots from its mouth totally incinerates all targets.

name: Lapras
description: Its high intelligence enables it to understand human speech. It likes to ferry people on its back.

name: Braixen
description: With friction from its tail fur,  it sets the twig on fire and launces into battle.

name: Eevee
description: An extremely rare POKéMON that may evolve in a number of different ways depending on stimuli.

name: Vaporeon
description: Its body's cellular structure is similar to the molecular composition of water. It can melt invisibly in water.

name: Jolteon
description: If it is angered or startled, the fur all over its body bristles like sharp needles that pierce foes.

name: Flareon
description: It has a flame bag inside its body. After inhaling deeply, it blows out flames of nearly 3,100 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Delphox
description: It gazes into the flame at the tip of its branch to achieve a focused state which let it see into the future.

name: Omanyte
description: A prehistoric POKéMON that lived in the primordial sea, it swims by twisting its 10 tentacles about.

name: Omastar
description: Its tentacles are highly developed as if they are hands and feet. As soon as it ensnares prey, it bites.

name: Kabuto
description: This POKéMON was regenerated from the fossil of an ancient creature. It protects itself with a hard shell.

name: Kabutops
description: It swims freely through water. It catches prey with its scythe-like arms and drains the victim's fluids.

name: Aerodactyl
description: It was regenerated from a dinosaur's genetic matter that was found in amber. It flies with high-pitched cries.

name: Snorlax
description: It is not satisfied unless it eats over 880 pounds of food every day. When it is done eating, it goes promptly to sleep.

name: Garchomp
description: It flies at speeds equal to a jet fighter. It never allows its prey to escape.

name: Electivire
description: As its electric charge amplifies, blue sparks begin to crackle  between its horns.

name: Magmortar
description: It blasts fireballs of over 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit from the ends of its arms.

name: Dratini
description: Even the young can exceed 6.5 feet in length. It grows larger by repeatedly shedding skin.

name: Dragonair
description: It is said to live in seas and lakes. Even though it has no wings, it has been seen flying occasionally.

name: Dragonite
description: It can fly in spite of its big and bulky physique. It circles the globe in just 16 hours.

name: Mamoswine
description: A frozen one was dug up from soil dating back 10,000 years. It woke up to much amazement.

name: Shaymin-s
description: A POKéMON of South America that was thought to have been extinct. It is very intelligent and learns any move.

name: Chikorita
description: It rarely appears before people. It is said to nest where lightning has fallen.

name: Bayleef
description: Strong feelings of hatred turned a puppet into a POKéMON.

name: Meganium
description: MEGANIUM's breath has the power to revive dead grass and plants. It can make them healthy again.

name: Cyndaquil
description: It usually stays hunched over. If it is angry or surprised, it shoots flames out of its back.

name: Quilava
description: This POKéMON is fully covered by nonflammable fur. It can withstand any kind of fire attack.

name: Typhlosion
description: It has a secret, devastating move. It rubs its blazing fur together to cause huge explosions.

name: Totodile
description: It is small but rough and tough. It won't hesitate to take a bite out of anything that moves.

name: Croconaw
description: It opens its huge jaws wide when attacking. If it loses any fangs while biting, they grow back in.

name: Feraligatr
description: It is hard for it to support its own weight out of water, so it gets down on all fours. But it moves fast.

name: Budew
description: It lives alongside clear ponds.It scatters pollen that induces harsh sneezing and runny noses.

name: Roserade
description: It attracts prey with a sweet aroma, then downs it with thorny whips hidden in its arms.

name: Hoothoot
description: It has a perfect sense of time. Whatever happens, it keeps rhythm by precisely tilting its head in time.

name: Noctowl
description: When it needs to think, it rotates its head 180 degrees to sharpen its intellectual power.

name: Flabebe
description: It draws out and controls the hidden  power of flowers. The flower Flabebe holds is part of its body.

name: Floette
description: When the flowers of a well-tended flower bed bloom, it appears and celebrates with a dance.

name: Spinarak
description: It spins a web using fine--but durable-- thread. It then waits patiently for prey to be trapped.

name: Ariados
description: A single strand of a special string is endlessly spun out of its rear. The string leads back to its nest.

name: Crobat
description: The development of wings on its legs enables it to fly fast but also makes it tough to stop and rest.

name: Chinchou
description: On the dark ocean floor, its only means of communication is its constantly flashing lights.

name: Lanturn
description: It blinds prey with an intense burst of light, then swallows the immobilized prey in a single gulp.

name: Helioptile
description: The frills on either side of its head have cells that generate electricity when exposed to sunlight.

name: Spritzee
description: It emits a scent that enraptures those who smell it.

name: Chatot
description: It mimics the cries of other Pokémon to trick them.

name: Joltik
description: Joltik that live in cities have learned a technique for sucking electricity from houses.

name: Galvantula
description: It creates barriers from electrified silk that stun foes.

name: Munna
description: It eats the dreams of people and Pokémon. When it eats a pleasant dream, it expels pink-colored mist.

name: Musharna
description: With the mist from its forehead, it can create shapes of things from dreams it has eaten.

name: Mareep
description: Its fleece grows continually. In the summer, the fleece is fully shed, but it grows back in a week.

name: Flaaffy
description: Its fluffy fleece easily stores electricity. Its rubbery hide keeps it from being electrocuted.

name: Ampharos
description: The bright light on its tail can be seen far away. It has been treasured since ancient times as a beacon.

name: Mismagius
description: Its cries sound like incantations to torment the foe. It appears where you least expect it.

name: Marill
description: The end of its tail serves as a buoy that keeps it from drowning, even in a vicious current.

name: Azumarill
description: When it plays in water, it rolls up its elongated ears to prevent their insides from getting wet.

name: Landorus
description: It creates energy to give nutrients tothe soil and make the land abundant.

name: Glaceon
description: It lowers its body heat to freeze its fur. The hairs then become like needles it can fire.

name: Keldeo
description: It crosses the world, running over the  of oceans and rivers.

name: Virizion
description: Legends say this Pokémon confounded opponents with its swift movements.

name: Cobalion
description: It has a body and heart of steel.

name: Aipom
description: It lives atop tall trees. When leaping from branch to branch, it deftly uses its tail for balance.

name: Petilil
description: The leaves on its head are very bitter. Eating one of these leaves can refresh a tired body.

name: Lilligant
description: The fragrance of the garland on hectic manner, but it comes to a complete its head has a relaxing effect but, taking care of it is very hard.

name: Yanma
description: Its large eyes can scan 360 degrees. It looks in all directions to seek out insects as its prey.

name: Tornadus
description: In every direction it flies, creating winds so powerful, they blow everything away.

name: Haxorus
description: Their sturdy tusks will stay sharp even if used to cut steel beams.

name: Espeon
description: By reading air currents, it can predict things such as the weather or its foe's next move.

name: Umbreon
description: When darkness falls, the rings on its body begin to glow, striking fear in the hearts of anyone nearby.

name: Murkrow
description: It is said that when chased, it lures its attacker onto dark mountain trails where the foe will get lost.

name: Durant
description: They attack in groups, covered by steel armor, to protect themselves from  Heatmor.

name: Misdreavus
description: It loves to bite and yank people's hair from behind without warning, just to see their shocked reactions.

name: Unown
description: Its flat, thin body is always stuck on walls. Its shape appears to have some meaning.

name: Heatran
description: It dwells in volcanic caves. It digs in with its cross-shaped feet to crawl on walls.

name: Girafarig
description: Its tail, which also contains a small brain, may bite on its own if it notices an alluring smell.

name: Pineco
description: It hangs and waits for flying-insect prey to come near. It does not move about much on its own.

name: Forretress
description: It remains immovably rooted to its tree. It scatters pieces of its hard shell to drive its enemies away.

name: Terrakion
description: This Pokémon came to the defense of Pokémon that had lost their homes.

name: Rhyperior
description: From holes in its palms, it fires out Geodude. Its carapace can withstand volcanic eruptions.

name: Steelix
description: It is said that if an ONIX lives for over 100 years, its composition changes to become diamond-like.

name: Snubbull
description: It has an active, playful nature. Many women like to frolic with it because of its affectionate ways.

name: Granbull
description: Because its fangs are too heavy, it always keeps its head tilted down. However, its BITE is powerful.

name: Qwilfish
description: The small spikes covering its body developed from scales. They inject a toxin that causes fainting.

name: Scizor
description: Its wings are not used for flying. They are flapped at high speed to adjust its body temperature.

name: Florges
description: In the past, governors of castles  would invite Florges  to create flower gardens in their rooms.

name: Heracross
description: Usually docile, but if disturbed while sipping honey, it chases off the intruder with its horn.

name: Sneasel
description: Vicious in nature, it drives PIDGEY from their nests and feasts on the eggs that are left behind.

name: Teddiursa
description: Before food becomes scarce in wintertime, its habit is to hoard food in many hidden locations.

name: Ursaring
description: With its ability to distinguish any smell, it unfailingly finds all food buried deep underground.

name: Slugma
description: A common sight in volcanic areas, it slowly slithers around in a constant search for warm places.

name: Magcargo
description: Its brittle shell occasionally spouts intense flames that circulate throughout its body.

name: Swinub
description: If it smells something enticing, it dashes off headlong to find the source of the aroma.

name: Piloswine
description: If it charges at an enemy, the hairs on its back stand up straight. It is very sensitive to sound.

name: Aurorus
description: Using its diamond-shaped crystals, it can instantly create a wall of ice to protect itself.

name: Finneon
description: The line running down its side can store sunlight. It shines vividly at night.

name: Lumineon
description: It lives on the deep-sea floor. It attracts prey by flashing the patterns on its four tail fins.

name: Probopass
description: It freely controls three small units called Mini-Noses using magnetic force.

name: M.Swampert
description: With one swing, they can batter  down its foe. It makes its nest on beautiful beaches.

name: Skarmory
description: After nesting in bramble bushes, the wings of its chicks grow hard from scratches by thorns.

name: M.Houndoom
description: To corner prey, they check each other's location using barks that only they can understand.

name: Houndoom
description: Upon hearing its eerie howls, other POKéMON get the shivers and head straight back to their nests.

name: Kingdra
description: It sleeps deep on the ocean floor to build its energy. It is said to cause tornadoes as it wakes.

name: Phanpy
description: As a sign of affection, it bumps with its snout. However, it is so strong, it may send you flying.

name: Donphan
description: The longer and bigger its tusks, the higher its rank in its herd. The tusks take a long time to grow.

name: Sylveon
description: It sends a soothing aura from its ribbonlike feelers to calm fights.

name: Stantler
description: Those who stare at its antlers will gradually lose control of their senses and be unable to stand.

name: Krookodile
description: Very violent Pokémon, they try to clamp  down on anything that moves  in front of their eyes.

name: Gible
description: It nests in small holes in cave walls. It pounches to catch its pray.

name: Hitmontop
description: It launches kicks while spinning. If it spins at high speed, it may bore its way into the ground.

name: Glameow
description: It hooks its claws into the nose of its Trainer if it isn't fed.

name: Elekid
description: Even in the most vicious storm, this POKéMON plays happily if thunder rumbles in the sky.

name: Magby
description: It is found in volcanic craters. Its body heat exceeds 1,100 degrees Fahrenheit, so don't underestimate it.

name: Miltank
description: If it has just had a baby, the milk it produces contains much more nutrition than usual.

name: Blissey
description: It has a very compassionate nature. If it sees a sick POKéMON, it will nurse the sufferer back to health.

name: Raikou
description: This POKéMON races across the land while barking a cry that sounds like crashing thunder.

name: Entei
description: A POKéMON that races across the land. It is said that one is born every time a new volcano appears.

name: Suicune
description: This POKéMON races across the land. It is said that north winds will somehow blow whenever it appears.

name: Bastiodon
description: Usually docile, but if disturbed while sipping honey, it chases off the intruder with its horn.

name: Archeops
description: Its wings are not used for flying. They are flapped at high speed to adjust its body temperature.

name: Tyranitar
description: Its body can't be harmed by any sort of attack, so it is very eager to make challenges against enemies.

name: Lugia
description: It is said to be the guardian of the seas. It is rumored to have been seen on the night of a storm.

name: Hydreigon
description: This brutal Pokémon travels the skies on it's six wings. Anything that mobes seems like a foe to it.

name: Celebi
description: When CELEBI disappears deep in a forest, it is said to leave behind an egg it brought from the future.

name: T.Unown
description: It quickly scales even vertical walls. It senses humidity with its tail to predict the next day's weather.

name: Meloetta A
description: Its strongly developed thigh muscles give it astounding agility and jumping performance.

name: Meloetta P
description: The leaves on its forelegs are as sharp as swords. It agilely leaps about the branches of trees to strike.

name: Dragalge
description: It has a flame sac inside its belly that perpetually burns. It feels warm if it is hugged.

name: Mienshao
description: It boosts its concentration by emitting harsh cries. Its kicks have outstanding destructive power.

name: Druddigon
description: When facing a tough foe, it looses flames from its wrists. Its powerful legs let it jump clear over buildings.

name: B.Unown
description: Its large tail fin propels it through water with powerful acceleration. It is strong in spite of its size.

name: Lucario
description: It is at its best when on muddy ground with poor footing. It quickly overwhelms foes struggling in mud.

name: Drapion
description: Its arms are rock-hard. With one swing, they can batter down its foe. It makes its nest on beautiful beaches.

name: Manaphy
description: It has a very tenacious nature. Its acute sense of smell lets it chase a chosen prey without ever losing track.

name: Mm
description: It will always obey the commands of a skilled TRAINER. Its behavior arises from its living in packs in ancient times.

name: Tartarus
description: A POKéMON with abundant curiosity. It shows an interest in everything, so it always zigs and zags.
When running in a straight line, it can top 60 miles per hour. However, it has a tough time with curved roads.

name: Remnant
description: It lives amidst tall grass and in forests. When attacked, it resists by pointing its venomous spikes at the foe.

name: D. Unown
description: It conserves its energy by moving as little as possible. It awaits evolution while drinking only a little rainwater.
Despite its appearance, it has an aggressive nature. It attacks by jabbing with its long, thin mouth.

name: Yveltal
description: Its body, which is made of soft silk, hardens over time. When cracks appear, evolution is near.

name: Malamar
description: It scatters horribly toxic dust when it senses danger. They tend to gather in the glow of streetlamps at night.

name: Bisharp
description: It searches about for clean water. If it does not drink water for too long, the leaf on its head wilts.

name: Darkrai
description: It lives at the water's edge where it is sunny. It sleeps on a bed of water grass by day and becomes active at night.

name: Regilava
description: The rhythm of bright, festive music activates LUDICOLO's cells, making it more powerful.

name: Regighoul
description: If it remains still, it becomes impossible to distinguish from real nuts. It delights in surprising foraging PIDGEY.

name: Regivenom
description: They live in holes bored in large trees. The sound of NUZLEAF's grass flute fills listeners with dread.

name: Deoxys
description: A POKéMON that was feared as a forest guardian. It can read the foe's mind and take preemptive action.

name: Metastacia
description: It dislikes cold seasons. They migrate to other lands in search of warmth, flying over 180 miles a day.

name: Treecko
description: If its two tail feathers are standing at attention, it is proof of good health. It soars elegantly in the sky.

name: Grovyle
description: It rides upon ocean winds as if it were a glider. In the winter, it hides food around its nest.

name: Sceptile
description: It is a flying transporter that carries small POKéMON in its beak. It bobs on the waves to rest its wings.

name: Torchic
description: A bewitching aroma wafts from its flower. The fragrance becalms those engaged in a battle.

name: Combusken
description: It has the power to predict the future. Its power peaks when it is protecting its TRAINER.

name: Blaziken
description: It has the power to predict the future. Its power peaks when it is protecting its TRAINER.

name: Mudkip
description: This Pokémon was believed to have been borned from the sun.

name: Marshtomp
description: When volcanic ash darkened the atmosphere, it is said that Volcarona's fire provided a  replacement for the sun.

name: Swampert
description: It prefers damp places. By day it remains still in the forest shade. It releases toxic powder from its head.

name: Poochyena
description: The seeds on its tail are made of toxic spores. It knocks out foes with quick, virtually invisible punches.

name: Mightyena
description: It sleeps for 20 hours every day. Making drowsy those that see it is one of its abilities.

name: Zigzagoon
description: It is always hungry because it won't stop rampaging. Even while it is eating, it can't keep still.

name: Linoone
description: It is the world's most slothful POKéMON. However, it can exert horrifying power by releasing pent-up energy all at once.

name: Wurmple
description: Because it lived almost entirely underground, it is nearly blind. It uses its antennae instead.

name: Silcoon
description: This POKéMON is so quick, it is said to be able to avoid any attack. It loves to feed on tree sap.

name: Beautifly
description: A most peculiar POKéMON that somehow appears in a POKé BALL when a NINCADA evolves.

name: Cascoon
description: It usually murmurs, but starts crying loudly if it senses danger. It stops when its ear covers are shut.

name: Dustox
description: When it stamps its feet and bellows, it generates ultrasonic waves that can blow apart a house.

name: Lotad
description: It emits a variety of sounds from the  holes all over its body. Its loud cries can be heard from over six miles away.

name: Lombre
description: It grows stronger by enduring harsh training. It is a gutsy POKéMON that can withstand any attack.

name: Ludicolo
description: It stomps on the ground to build power. It can send a 10-ton truck flying with a straight-arm punch.

name: Seedot
description: Inflating its poison sacs, it makes an eerie blubbering sound for intimidation.

name: Nuzleaf
description: Its magnetic nose consistently faces north. Travelers check NOSEPASS to get their bearings.

name: Shiftry
description: It is said to be difficult to earn its trust. However, it is extremely popular for its cute looks and behavior.

name: Nincada
description: The favorite of trend-conscious female TRAINERS, they are used in competition for their style and fur.

name: Ninjask
description: It freezes prey by blowing its icy breath. It is said to then secretly display its prey.

name: Shedinja
description: A single Heliolisk can generate sufficient electricity to power a skyscraper.

name: Taillow
description: Its skull is as hard as iron. t is a brute that tears down jungle trees while catching prey.

name: Swellow
description: Nothing could stop this Pokemon 100 million years ago, so it behaved like like a king.

name: Shroomish
description: It claims a large mountain as its sole territory. It mercilessly thrashes those that violate its space.

name: Breloom
description: It never skips its daily yoga training. It heightens its inner strength through meditation.

name: Deoxyss
description: It elegantly avoids attacks with dance- like steps, then launches a devastating blow in the same motion.

name: Wingull
description: It stores static electricity in its fur for discharging. It gives off sparks if a storm approaches.

name: Pelipper
description: It rarely appears before people. It is said to nest where lightning has fallen.

name: Larvesta
description: Countless charred remains mar the the landscape of places through which  Thundurus has passed.

name: Volcarona
description: Shiny particles are released from its wings like a veil. It is said to represent the crescent moon.

name: Wailmer
description: It shrouds itself in sand to ward off germs. It travels easily through  the sands of the desert.

name: Wailord
description: Surprisingly quick to anger. It holds its mouth agape as a display  of strength.

name: Skitty
description: Its flowers give off a relaxing fragrance. The stronger its aroma, the healthier the ROSELIA is.

name: Delcatty
description: When its internal fire flares up, its movements grow sharper  and faster.

name: Gabite
description: It has mastered fast and powerful  fighting moves. It grows a  beard of fire.

name: Baltoy
description: It lives in massive rivers that course through jungles. It swarms prey that enter its territory.

name: Claydol
description: The ruffian of the seas, it has fangs that crunch through iron. It swims by jetting water from its rear.

name: Nosepass
description: When it sucks in a large volume of seawater, it becomes like a big, bouncy ball. It eats a ton of food daily.

name: Torkoal
description: It is among the largest of all POKéMON. It herds prey in a pack then swallows the massed prey in one gulp.

name: Froslass
description: It crushes its foe under its heavy body to cause fainting.

name: Barboach
description: It avoids unnecessary disputes, but it will decimate anything that threatens its pride.

name: Whiscash
description: It burns coal inside its shell. If it is attacked, it belches thick, black smoke and flees.

name: Aromatisse
description: It apparently dies if it stops bouncing about. It carries a pearl from CLAMPERL on its head.

name: Corphish
description: It can gain control over foes by doing odd dance steps. The black pearls on its forehead are precious gems.

name: Crawdaunt
description: A Pokémon that mutated from an extraterrestrial  virus exposed to a laser beam.

name: Feebas
description: It lives in arid deserts. It makes a sloping pit trap in sand where it patiently awaits prey.

name: Milotic
description: It generates ultrasonic waves by violently flapping its wings. After making its prey faint, it melts the prey with acid.

name: Carvanha
description: It hides itself by kicking up desert sand with its wings. Red covers shield its eyes from sand.

name: Sharpedo
description: It prefers harsh environments such as deserts. It can survive for 30 days on water stored in its body.

name: Trapinch
description: It lives in deserts. It becomes active at night when it hunts for prey exhausted from the desert's heat.

name: Vibrava
description: It constantly grooms its cotton-like wings. It takes a shower to clean itself if it becomes dirty.

name: Flygon
description: If you hear a beautiful melody trilling deep among mountains far from people, it is ALTARIA's humming.

name: Makuhita
description: If it comes across a SEVIPER, its fur bristles and it assumes its battle pose. Its sharp claws are its best weapon.

name: Hariyama
description: It sharpens its swordlike tail on hard rocks. It hides in tall grass and strikes unwary prey with venomous fangs.

name: Electrike
description: When it changes form, an aurora appears. It absorbs attacks by altering its cellular  structure.

name: Manectric
description: Deoxys emerged from a virus that came from space.  It is highly intelligent and wields  psychokinetic powers.

name: E.Rapidash
description: It probes muddy riverbeds with its two long whiskers. A slimy film protects its body.

name: Empoleon
description: It makes its nest at the bottom of  swamps. It will eat anything - if it is alive, WHISCASH will eat it.

name: Spheal
description: It came from overseas. It is a very hardy creature that will quickly proliferate, even in polluted streams.

name: Sealeo
description: A rough customer that wildly flails its giant claws. It is said to be extremely hard to raise.

name: Walrein
description: It was discovered in ancient ruins. While moving, it constantly spins. It stands on one foot even when asleep.

name: Cacnea
description: It appears to have been born from clay dolls made by ancient people. It uses telekinesis to float and move.

name: Cacturne
description: It became extinct roughly 100 million years ago. It was regenerated from a fossil using advanced techniques.

name: Snorunt
description: It ensnares prey with its eight tentacles. It then melts the prey with a strong acid before feeding.

name: Glalie
description: It is a kind of POKéMON progenitor. It uses its extending claws to catch prey hiding among rocks on the seafloor.

name: Deoxysd
description: Protected by a hard shell, its body is very sturdy. It skewers prey with its claws to feed.

name: Deoxysa
description: Ridiculed for its shabby appearance, it is ignored by researchers. It lives in ponds choked with weeds.

name: Croagunk
description: MILOTIC is breathtakingly beautiful. Those that see it are said to forget their combative spirits.

name: Spoink
description: To make itself appear intimidatingly beefy, it tightly cinches its waist with its tails.

name: Grumpig
description: It loves sparkly things. It seeks treasures in caves.

name: Thundurus
description: It loves to feed on feelings like envy and malice. Its upright horn catches the emotions of people.

name: Cresselia
description: Strong feelings of hatred turned a puppet into a POKéMON. If it opens its mouth, its cursed energy escapes.

name: Heliolisk
description: Making itself invisible, it silently sneaks up to prey. It has the ability to slip through thick walls.

name: Meditite
description: Its body is entirely hollow. When it opens its mouth, it sucks everything in as if it were a black hole.

name: Medicham
description: It lives in tropical jungles. The bunch of fruit around its neck is delicious. The fruit grows twice a year.

name: Swablu
description: Legends say it can share eternal life. It slept for a thousand years in the  form of a tree.

name: Altaria
description: It appears when it senses an impending natural disaster. As a result, it was mistaken as a doom-bringer.

name: Dusknoir
description: It is said to take lost spirits into its pliant body and guide them home.

name: Duskull
description: It is said that a home visited by a SNORUNT will prosper. It can withstand cold of minus 150 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Dusclops
description: It has a body of ice that won't melt, even with fire. It can instantly freeze moisture in the atmosphere.

name: Roselia
description: Its body is covered in fluffy fur. The fur keeps it from feeling cold while it is rolling on ice.

name: Slakoth
description: It touches new things with its nose to test for smell and feel. It plays by spinning SPHEAL on its nose.

name: Vigoroth
description: It swims through icy seas while shattering ice floes with its large tusks. It is protected by its thick blubber.

name: Slaking
description: The leaves on its forelegs are as sharp as swords.

name: Pignite
description: It appears when it senses an impending natural disaster. As a result, it was mistaken as a doom-bringer.

name: Emboar
description: It flies at speeds equal to a jet fighter. It never allows its prey to escape.

name: Tropius
description: It has remained unchanged for 100 million years. It was discovered during a deep-sea exploration.

name: Whismur
description: It emits various scents that  its enemies  dislike in order to gain an  edge  in battle.

name: Loudred
description: Its steel-hard head can shatter boulders. It longingly hopes for wings to grow so it can fly.

name: Exploud
description: Its armored body makes all attacks bounce off. The armor is too tough, however, making it heavy and somewhat sluggish.

name: M.Sceptile
description: It becomes uncontrollable if it is enraged. It destroys everything with shredding claws and fire.

name: M.Absol
description: Once they grip an enemy, they won't release until the foe is torn.

name: M.Garchomp
description: It floats midair using magnetism. Its body is so tough, even a crash with a jet plane won't leave a scratch.

name: Absol
description: It is formed by two METANG fusing. Its four brains are said to be superior to a supercomputer.

name: Shuppet
description: It is entirely composed of rocks with no sign of a brain or heart. It is a mystery even to modern scientists.

name: Banette
description: Research revealed that its body is made of the same kind of ice that is found at the South Pole.

name: Seviper
description: It is sturdier than any kind of metal. It hardened due to pressure underground over tens of thousands of years.

name: Zangoose
description: It can telepathically communicate with people. It changes its appearance using its down that refracts light.

name: Relicanth
description: It has a docile temperament and dislikes fighting. Tucking in its forelegs, it can fly faster than a jet plane.

name: Rampardos
description: This POKéMON is said to have expanded the sea by bringing heavy rains. It has the power to control water.

name: Tyrantrum
description: This legendary POKéMON is said to represent the land. It went to sleep after dueling KYOGRE.

name: Aggron
description: It has lived for hundreds of millions of years in the ozone layer. Its flying form looks like a meteor.

name: Purugly
description: It can instantly create many diamonds by compressing the carbon in the air between its hands.

name: Hippopotas
description: There is an enduring legend that  states this Pokémon towed  continents with ropes.
